messages:
Kelly S.: Hey team — Acme Capital is asking for our assurance docs to move the POC forward. They want: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed), a pen-test attestation/letter, and a short inventory of network controls + KMS details. They need this by EOD Friday to keep the POC start next week. Any blockers?
Alex W.: I can assemble the SOC2 redacted bundle and the pen-test attestation draft. Quick Q: do they need the full scope (prod + staging) or just hosted API scope?
Kelly S.: They said the scope should cover hosted API + dedicated (they plan to test both).
Alex W.: OK. Hosted + dedicated. I'll prepare: 1) redacted SOC2 Type II PDF, 2) pen-test attestation letter (signed by our vendor), 3) a one-page controls inventory (network, IAM, KMS). I'll upload to the secure bucket and share a link. ETA: tomorrow noon.
Maria S.: FYI engineering can pull the config snapshots and KMS config notes — will need a ticket though. How much detail on KMS? key rotation cadence + key access list ok?
Alex W.: That should be fine. Keep anything sensitive redacted (key IDs okay, not plaintext keys). Add rotation cadence, who has CMK access (roles), and whether HSM backed.
Jamal R.: Also need to confirm pricing for the POC — Acme asked if a short-term dedicated node is possible and what's the monthly pro‑rata. @Kelly S. can you confirm their committed qps?
Kelly S.: They confirmed target 600 qps burst for inference, average ~120 qps. Want a 2-week POC on a small dedicated pool.
Jamal R.: OK — I'll draft a short quote: 2-week dedicated pool + support credit. Won't need full contract yet, just PO estimate.
security-bot: New ticket created: #SEC-4482 (Acme assurance package). Assigned to Alex W. — https://redwood.internal/ticket/SEC-4482
Alex W.: Uploaded preliminary artifacts to secure bucket: s3://redwood-secure/customer-acme/1782151123/ — sharing link via DM to their security contact. Pen-test vendor letter is pending vendor signature, I requested signature this morning.
Maria S.: For the config snapshots, I'll add the `nginx` ingress rules, VPC peering matrix, and egress-blocklist excerpt. Writing up notes on access controls now.
Kelly S.: Amazing — two asks from Acme before Friday: 1) signed pen-test attestation (or vendor letter) 2) SOC2 redacted PDF + controls inventory. Can we meet that?
Alex W.: Likely yes. If vendor delays signature, we'll provide a signed attestation from Redwood + vendor notice and follow up with vendor letter within 48h. Will cc @Kelly S. on delivery.
Jamal R.: I'll include the POC price estimate in the package so PS can start PO approval.
Kelly S.: Thanks all. If anything slips, ping me. I'll follow up with Acme security: "we have docs ready, vendor letter pending; signature expected within 48h." :thumbsup:
